name: Sir Zaraya
description: Darien's finest knight, who leads the Balduvia mission and later hands the Nova Pentacle to Freyalise.

description_citations.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
description_citations.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Darien sends Sir Zaraya and the finest knights to Balduvia in answer to a nomad plea.
timeline.quote: He summons Sir Zaraya and orders her to collect the finest Knights of Kjeldor and to travel to Balduvia .

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Frozen Dead". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samiks dies, giving Zaraya a Nova Pentacle.
timeline.quote: In his dying breath, Samiks gifts his last relic to Zaraya.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Frozen Dead". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The knights defeat Lim-Dul with the Winds of Kataba and Word of Undoing; Leshrac leaves him in an Icy Prison.
timeline.quote: Leshrac is not pleased and leaves Lim-Dûl stuck in an Icy Prison

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Frozen Dead". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Onala resigns from the Order and Zaraya and Kailo reconcile over their son's death.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Frozen Dead". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Freyalise, disguised, convinces Zaraya to hand over the Nova Pentacle and prophesizes Jaeuhl as champion.
timeline.quote: Prophesizing that Jaeuhl will be the champion in the final battle

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Forever Silent the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Freyalise asks Kaysa to help cast her greatest spell, admitting she cannot guarantee the child's safety.
timeline.quote: Freyalise, revealing her blind eyes, admits that she can not.
